title: Live sessions — live-session@1 (Opus build)
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: rule: every assistant in the framework keeps its sessions live — a session is owned by its host, never by the browser; closing a tab/app only detaches, any device reattaches and replays; a session ends only when closed on purpose. Kernel contract unchanged (`framework/core/live-session.ts` = Kotlin

commits.message: Live sessions (live-session@1): assistant sessions stay live when the browser closes
